label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 216 ]

blocks.text: In autumn, the leaves of many trees turn yellow, orange, and red. During spring and summer, leaves are green because they are full of chlorophyll, which plants use to make food from sunlight. As the days get shorter and cooler, trees stop making chlorophyll, and the green color slowly disappears. Yellow and orange colors, which were in the leaves all along, can then be seen. Red colors are different: many trees produce them only in autumn, especially when the days are sunny and the nights are cool. That is why autumn reds are especially bright in years with many sunny days and cool nights.

readingSentences.korean: 가을이 되면 많은 나무의 잎이 노란색, 주황색, 빨간색으로 변한다.

readingSentences.korean: 낮이 짧아지고 서늘해지면 나무는 엽록소를 더 만들지 않고, 초록색이 서서히 사라진다.

readingSentences.korean: 그러면 줄곧 잎 속에 있던 노란색과 주황색이 보이게 된다.

readingSentences.english: Red colors are different: many trees produce them only in autumn, especially when the days are sunny and the nights are cool.
readingSentences.korean: 빨간색은 다르다. 많은 나무가 가을에만 이 색을 새로 만들어 내는데, 특히 낮에 햇볕이 좋고 밤이 서늘할 때 그렇다.

readingSentences.korean: 그래서 햇볕 좋은 낮과 서늘한 밤이 많은 해에는 가을 단풍의 붉은색이 특히 선명하다.
